source: Owner direct chat after discussing environmental destruction before Utility AI implementation
owner_message_original: Давай тогда подробим на задачки, скопируем лобби и будем постепенно заставлять его разрушающимися объектами. И на них проверять, нужно в уме держать и оптимизацию, но постараться не в ущерб качеству. Что скажешь на счет производительности? основная нагрузка же идет на процессор?
owner_message_english_translation: Let us break it into tasks, copy the lobby and gradually fill it with destructible objects, testing on them. Keep optimization in mind, preferably without sacrificing quality. What about performance: is the main load on the processor?
decision: Prioritize a destruction laboratory in a separate copy of the retained lobby. Decompose MSQ-74 into sequential child tasks, preserve visual and gameplay quality while measuring cost as object density increases, and separate later AI integration.
authorized_now: Administrative task and dependency preparation in existing Multica
Create and verify one isolated lobby map copy with preservation and baseline inventory under ED-00
Launch existing local services/editor needed for the authorized copy
execution_boundary: ED-00 may execute now. Later children describe the incremental implementation route; preparation does not automatically dispatch them or select new object art. Owner gameplay/visual judgement remains separate; earlier task-specific testing reservations are not universally revoked.
preservation: Preserve source map, unsaved owner state, shared assets, editable sources, owner config changes and all prior evidence. Duplicate assets that require lab-specific edits; handle external actors and map-owned dependencies through verified editor facilities. No duplicate project/worktree.
scope: Existing reusable nonstructural objects and their rifle-driven damage, debris, reset and measured incremental placement. No renewed lobby architecture, whole-building collapse, structural redesign, deferred glazing refinement or approved new art is implied.
dependencies: MSQ-74 laboratory and specimens no longer wait for MSQ-72 or Utility AI replacement. MSQ-131 remains dependent on actual destruction evidence and new AI cover/navigation; rubble traversal remains separately integrated in MSQ-78 with applicable support contracts.
quality_policy: Optimize active simulation, collision complexity, sleeping, event-driven updates, rendering and effect scalability from measurements. Do not silently erase visible destruction, remove gameplay collision, freeze all movable debris or lower visual settings to claim success.
supersedes: Earlier ordering that places the initial MSQ-74 specimen after MSQ-72, and the blanket lobby deferral only for this isolated copy and destruction-lab scope. Other paused scopes and accepted evidence are unchanged.
